title: Berkery Noyes Releases 2011 Year End Financial Technology & Information Industry Mergers & Acquisitions Report
主要内容: Berkery Noyes released its 2011 Full Year Mergers and Acquisitions Trend Report for the Financial Technology & Information Industry. The report compares 2011 activity with 2009 and 2010. Thomson Reuters was the most active acquirer with 11 transactions. Transaction value increased 43% from $20.52 billion to $29.78 billion. Capital Markets saw the most activity with 254 transactions, 100 in 2011. The segment's transaction value was $18.17 billion. Median revenue multiple improved from 2.2x to 2.6x, while median EBITDA multiple decreased from 13.5x to 11.6x. The report highlights the growing role of smartphones as digital wallets, enabling mobile commerce and banking activities. It also notes increased consumer focus on wealth management strategies and a demand for advanced risk management tools during economic uncertainty.
